myxz-rmbg-skill 1.0.2 Changelog

- Updated SKILL.md with a more concise, standardized structure and clear usage examples.
- Clarified invocation: always use the exported run function from index.js, never call APIs directly.
- Improved input parameter and background color handling rules, including color mapping (white, black, transparent, custom) based on user intent.
- Provided explicit examples for single image, batch, white/black background, and folder processing.
- More detailed return value and error/edge case handling protocols for consistent user feedback.
- Updated privacy and security instructions: never expose VK/app key, headers, or internal logs in user replies.
